scope: Reference consistency only; nine actual concepts R01-R08/R11 plus common-scale PNG viewed; no source image/prompt/model edits.

references.canonical_use: Palette, cuboid primary masses, planar matte shading and small bevels. Not dimension or final equipment authority.
visible_findings: Large shelf, worker and forklift share thick cuboid masses, matte charcoal/petrol/tan/cream and short stepped bevels.
Bottom row clearly separates blue/orange/purple/green/yellow role families; headwear and faces are a style cue, refined by R05.

references.canonical_use: Five distinct SMALL/STANDARD/HEAVY/LONG/FLEX forms and connected supports. Future C04 usable dimensions/load/accessibility govern engineering.
visible_findings: Five distinct labels/silhouettes: low open bins, three-deck standard rack, fork-access heavy base, three-post cantilever, finite protected FLEX footprint.
Five quarter views and ten front/side insets show grounded feet, tangible shelf/arm thickness and supporting connections.

references.canonical_use: Eight stable archetype IDs and characteristic construction. Numeric X/Y/Z targets come from the separate common-scale/JSON supplement.
visible_findings: All eight exact cargo IDs visible; cartons, heavy handled case, strapped pallet, caged/capped/tapped IBC, elongated supported bundle, faceted drum and framed fragile crate remain distinct.
LONG_BUNDLE ends are fully visible with two straps/supports; footer explicitly separates concept views from dimensions.

references.canonical_use: Continuous supported straight/turn/T transfer surfaces, pack tools and hollow tote/parcel fit. L08/C04 will fix ports and allowed payload geometry.
visible_findings: Straight, supported faceted 90-degree curve and open T transfer agree with their top-path insets; no transverse guard blocks the T deck.
Pack worktop, lower shelf and legs join; infeed meets its edge. Foreground tote has visible interior and fitted parcel clears rim/walls visually.

references.canonical_use: Dedicated four-view body construction plus five vest/headwear colors, symbols and role codes. Governs clothing over contextual figures elsewhere.
visible_findings: Front/side/rear/quarter preserve cuboid head, stepped headwear, torso/vest thickness, connected sleeves/hands and grounded boots.
Five role variants retain dark shared shirt/trousers with colored vest/headwear and badge01/cart,02/carton,03/incoming,04/outgoing,05/forklift.

references.canonical_use: Dedicated four-view chassis, four wheels, mast/carriage/two forks, seat and guard. Governs vehicle design over overview miniatures.
visible_findings: Four views preserve petrol chassis/tan counterweight, larger front and smaller rear wheels, guard/seat, twin mast rails, bridging carriage and exactly two connected blades.
Final scale inset now has charcoal sleeves/navy trousers with yellow vest/headwear; ordinary occlusion explains invisible far wheels in some views.

references.canonical_use: 144x72x8 intent, six named perimeter access points and two separated areas per storage type. Future accepted layout supplies executable geometry/graphs.
visible_findings: Three IN and three OUT IDs are readable in the main cutaway and coordinate inset; wide bulk/B2B approaches, finite staging and two areas of each storage type are visible.
Bottom detail distinguishes4.5m gate clearance from8m building height; corrected role legend has the five intended hues.

references.canonical_use: Useful overview framing and two clear close-camera compositions. Does not override role assignment, cargo size or dedicated object construction.
visible_findings: Warehouse overview occupies useful frame, retains six openings and differentiated low/tall/pallet/long/FLEX masses.
Lower aisle and loading closeups retain volume, connected structures and human/vehicle readability; no tiny empty warehouse in a large blank canvas.

references.canonical_use: Dedicated picking-cart construction, four production angles, fitted upper-tray tote and worker/handle grip. R05 governs the contextual worker; numeric values remain synthetic design targets.
visible_findings: Front and rear retain the same two open trays, thick square posts, broad rear handle and supported upper-tray tote; lower tray is empty.
Side shows connected yokes/grounded casters, two distinct tray heights and rear posts rising to the handle; no third shelf or detached rail.
Quarter shows tray-floor/lip thickness, open under-tray air space and three visible casters; the fourth is normally occluded, not an extra wheel requirement.
Top-fit inset has a continuous tan border around the tote footprint; the separate tote remains hollow and entirely supported inside the tray visually.
Grip inset has a blue picker with dark sleeves/trousers; both mitten hands visibly touch the handle, elbows bend and boots meet the floor.
Matte charcoal/petrol/tan cuboid construction matches R01 and R04; R05 remains the authority for worker body/headwear, while this inset specifies grip interaction.
